body: One of the best choice for Elephants gathering and on a lucky day you could witness a bunch of elephants in excess of 200+ its my definite choice over pinnawala orphanage
title: One to witness Beasts roam free

body: We spent about 3-4 hrs here in the late afternoon and saw so so many elephants. We saw different herds of different sizes and ages. They were feeding, bathing in the water. We were quite close and just watched them carry on with their normal behaviour. There were multiple jeeps but not so many, this could be different during peak season.We also saw different birds including an eagle and water buffalo. Our driver was great, very respectful towards the animals.It was certainly a highlight to our trip and an amazing experience to watch these animals. I feel very privileged especially to see them in their natural environment.Great to support this national park.
title: Amazing experience

body: We saw roughly 160 elephants throughout the tour, many babies, and one calf who was merely 1.5 weeks old! I gave it a 4/5 only because it is just elephants, water buffalo and some birds - no other expected wildlife. It wasn't overly crowded, roughly 4 or 5 jeeps at every siting, compared to some of the other parks where you can be queued for 30-40 minutes before you get to see the animal.
title: Elephants!
1day visit together with Sigiriya
body: first I visited Sigiriya, then mu guide recommended mi to go to see elephants, I paid 10000LRT for trip in 4x4 car. It worth to go, I saw over 30 elephants

title: Elephants galore
body: Fantastic national park we saw at least 100 elephants some of them were babies. We also saw water buffalo and a wide variety of birds. We spent 4hrs in the park and after speaking to other guests we realised we got a good deal unlike some safaris that only take you for 2hrs. We would recommend using Kalum safaris as he was very knowledgeable.

title: Amazing Jeep Safari
body: We went on the jeep safari ride in Minneriya National Park which was amazing, and saw about 150 wild elephants, a few monkeys, a group of water buffalo, pelicans, crocodiles, peacocks, eagles and other birds. I would strongly recommend you go in the jeep with the driver and a guide, as the guide can not only take you to the best areas to see wildlife but also keep the monkeys away from you! As funny as monkeys are they can get vicious and bite/scratch you if they get too close. The jeep had no roof or windows, so make sure you wear a hat and lots of sun cream. It cost us around £80 for 2 people.

title: Good afternoon animal spotting
body: This is by no means the same experience as an African safari but great nonetheless. We saw a variety of birds, plenty of elephants (with young) and crocs in one afternoon. Knowledgeable driver/spotter is a must.

title: Good experience but beware overpriced jeep safari
body: Park was good overall with lots of elephants to see, some water buffalo and other small birds. Be aware of jeep safari drivers who overcharge you, place called Compass Safari charged us 21000 lkr for two when it should have only cost approx 15,000 lkr. The jeep broke down mid way and was stuck in hot weather for half hour for another jeep. Suggest to compare prices before committing.

title: Average Safari
body: It is nice to see Elephant in their natural habitat, beautiful. You might also see some Birds and eagles. Not a wow factor but good experience

title: A fantastic experience!
body: We have spent a few hours in the park and have been able to see many kinds of animals, including a lot of bird species, buffalos, and most importantly, elephants! Nature there is beautiful, and it was so nice to see elephants in a wild habitat! It is definitely worth a detour!

title: What an experience
body: Whilst visiting the cultural triangle a visit is a must. Being at such close range to the elephant herds is a pretty unique experience that will by a life long memory that was really special.

title: NICE EXPERIENCE
body: Took a chance to see elephants in natural habitat. Saw hundreds of them from close quarters. Some were evn days old. It was hearth warming to see the majestic animals so closely grazing and even some younger ones were playing. Saw and heard them trumpetting . Even happened to see a herd of deers, coloured storks, pelicans, peacocks and some otherr birds in the Minneriya National Park. Worth the money.

title: Lots of Elephants
body: We went to Minnerya to see elephants, and elephants is what we saw a lot of. All sizes, and some so close you could almost reach out and touch them if it was allowed. The track in was a bit rough and there was little other widlife apart from a few water buffalo. Was not cheap at just over US $100 for jeep, admission etc, but was a unique experience. Late afternoon is best, we went at 3pm.
